instruction: I have many slides and need to quickly navigate between them. Please open the Navigator panel so I can see the presentation structure and jump to specific slides.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(2)

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to open the Navigator panel in LibreOffice Impress. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for Navigator panel/window elements.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction: checks accessibility tree for Navigator panel presence and visibility
Complete coverage: instruction asks to open Navigator panel, evaluator checks if Navigator is visible in accessibility tree
Visibility check properly implemented: code checks st:showing attribute and handles missing attribute case (assumes visible if present in tree)
Tag-agnostic approach: iterates through all elements without tag filtering, avoiding false negatives from unexpected tag names
Correct expected value handling: uses empty rules dict as metric only checks presence, not specific values
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: could add fallback for localized Navigator names, though this is unlikely to be an issue as 'Navigator' is typically not localized in LibreOffice
